title: The Secret Angles of Triangles
description: Discover the hidden rule that governs every single triangle drawn in the universe.
character_reference: a young geometry enthusiast with wavy brown hair wearing a yellow sweater and holding a wooden drafting compass

scenes.narration: Draw any triangle you like on a piece of paper, whether it is tall, skinny, wide, or lopsided.
scenes.visual: pencil drawing sharp clean triangle lines onto heavy textured paper with a wooden ruler

scenes.narration: Take a pair of scissors and carefully snip off all three corners of your freshly drawn triangle.
scenes.visual: sharp metal scissors neatly cutting the pointy corners off a colored paper triangle

scenes.narration: Now line those three separate corner pieces up side by side along the edge of your desk.
scenes.visual: fingers arranging three cut paper triangle corners side by side in a straight horizontal row

scenes.narration: Remarkably, the three sharp tips will always form a perfectly flat straight line together every single time.
scenes.visual: close up of paper corners fitting together seamlessly to form a straight horizontal edge

scenes.narration: In geometry, a flat straight line measures exactly one hundred eighty degrees from end to end.
scenes.visual: glowing protractor graphic showing a semi circle angle measurement of one hundred eighty degrees

scenes.narration: That means the interior angles of every triangle in existence always add up to one hundred eighty degrees.
scenes.visual: chalkboard diagram showing angle measurements adding up inside a large sketched triangle

scenes.narration: This simple rule allows architects and builders to construct sturdy bridges and skyscrapers that stand strong.
scenes.visual: stunning view of a massive steel truss bridge structure under a clear blue sky

scenes.narration: If you love uncovering simple rules that govern shapes, follow along for more daily math stories.
scenes.visual: smiling character holding a drafting tool and waving happily in a cozy study
